candidate_evidence.quote: Participants with recurrent primary CNS tumors harboring BRAF V600E mutations will receive plixorafenib, continuously in 3-week cycles until disease progression, unacceptable toxicity, or other reason for withdrawal.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Participants with recurrent primary CNS tumors harboring BRAF V600E mutations will receive plixorafenib

role_evidence.quote: The objective of this Master Protocol is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of plixorafenib in participants with BRAF altered

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational oral BRAF inhibitor (class 1 and class 2 alterations)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: inhibitor of BRAF Class 1 and Class 2 alterations

source_quote.quote: Documented BRAF V600E mutation in tumor and/or liquid biopsy detected by an analytically validated test at CLIA or CLIA-equivalent laboratory approved by sponsor or sponsor-designated central test.
Documentation of BRAF gene fusion in tumor and/or blood detected by an analytically validated test by DNA sequencing or RNA (transcriptome) sequencing.

coder_notes: Master protocol across solid tumours and primary CNS tumours with BRAF alterations; glioblastoma is named in the Subprotocol B inclusion criteria (basket). Ages include children (8 years and older). Every subprotocol requires a BRAF alteration (V600E, or fusion in Subprotocol A), so these are coded as eligibility, one row per alteration type. Cobicistat is mentioned only in an exclusion criterion of Subprotocol A (absorption) and is not a registered intervention, so it is not listed. Pharmacokinetics are plasma only.
